Vulnerabilities.Title: openssl: DH key generation issue
Vulnerabilities.Description: Applications that use the OpenSSL API DH_generate_key() may be vulnerable to a timing side-channel attack.

Vulnerabilities.Title: glibc: Buffer overflow in dynamic loader ld.so
Vulnerabilities.Description: A buffer overflow in glibc's dynamic loader when processing GLIBC_TUNABLES.

Vulnerabilities.Title: openssl: Denial of service via crafted AES-XTS key
Vulnerabilities.Description: Input buffer overread in AVX10 AES-XTS implementation.

Vulnerabilities.Title: semver: Regular Expression Denial of Service
Vulnerabilities.Description: Versions of semver prior to 7.5.2 are vulnerable to ReDoS.
